acceptanceCriteria: Interpolated and heredoc block calls count as calls (no BLOCK-NOT-CALLED), with tests
A block stored then called on every path is not flagged; a stored block never called is flagged or abstains with a named reason
Helpers defined in a same-file module that is `include`d into the example group are resolved; tests cover flagged and non-flagged cases
Spec TSA-V0 requirements updated; spec-requirements-check and focused testsource/testvalidity tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1824 (PR #1141, TSA-V0-054..056). The rule reads only the helper body's plain code: a block call inside string interpolation or a heredoc is not read (TSA-V0-055), a block stored in an ivar/local and called later is not followed, and helpers defined in an `include`d module are not resolved. Each is a false-negative or abstention class. Expected: the reader either recognises these forms (interpolation `#{block.call}`, `@b = block; ... @b.call`, module helpers in the same file) or reports a named abstention reason instead of silent non-coverage. Observed against Core built from origin/main at 19b2f18b6, 2026-10-18.
title: test-validity: BLOCK-NOT-CALLED abstains on block calls inside string interpolation/heredocs, stored blocks and included modules
